headline: Unlocking the Sacred Codes of Hidden India

profile.name: Svagato
profile.quote: Travel is not geography; it is the recalibration of human perception.

bio_paragraph_1: Greetings. I am Svagato—an author, linguist, and researcher of human consciousness. My life's work exists at the intersection of language science, sacred geography, and living philosophy.
bio_paragraph_2: Most travelers experience India only on its physical surface—its crowded bazaars and popular monuments. I practice this bespoke craft because true travel is an elevation of the human spirit. When you decode the ancient Sanskrit root structures of temple architecture or understand the acoustic dynamics of Vedic soundscapes, India ceases to be a destination—it becomes a mirror to your inner world.

expertise.description: Translating mythic symbols into clear, modern philosophy.
